name: oasdiff
description: OpenAPI 3 spec diff and breaking-change detector — compares two OpenAPI specs (YAML/JSON), reports diffs, breaking changes, and changelog with detailed classification

oasdiff.description: CLI for diffing OpenAPI 3 specs, detecting breaking changes, and producing markdown/yaml/json/html changelogs for API contract gating
oasdiff.usage:
oasdiff --version
oasdiff diff old.yaml new.yaml
oasdiff diff old.yaml new.yaml -f text
oasdiff breaking old.yaml new.yaml
oasdiff breaking old.yaml new.yaml --fail-on WARN
oasdiff changelog old.yaml new.yaml
oasdiff changelog old.yaml new.yaml -f markdown
oasdiff summary old.yaml new.yaml
